article.title: Vigloo徵集AI短劇試播片，選中作品有機會製成系列
article.summary: 韓國短劇平台Vigloo公布第二屆全球短劇徵集，邀創作者提交試播片及首五集大綱。
highlights: 獲簽約者可獲製作點數，成片由平台發行並分成。
article.why: 短內容團隊可先用一集驗證人物和故事能否延續成系列。
article.next_step: 準備試播片前先核對素材授權、製作支援及發行分成條款。
article.detail: Vigloo公布，參加者須以不超過三分鐘的影片展示短劇構想，並提交首五集大綱。公司稱會考慮投稿作品是否適合製成系列，獲邀簽約者才涉及製作點數、發行和分成。團隊可先確認角色、聲音及素材授權是否涵蓋首集以外的後續製作及發行。比賽名次與平台的製作決定分開處理。
article.title_en: Vigloo seeks AI microdrama pilots with a path to series production
article.summary_en: South Korean short-drama platform Vigloo announced its second global festival, inviting a pilot video and a synopsis for the first five episodes.
highlights_en: Submitted videos can run up to three minutes.
Creators who sign a deal can receive production credits, with platform distribution and revenue sharing.
article.why_en: Short-form teams can use one episode to assess whether characters and story can sustain a series.
article.next_step_en: Check rights, production support and distribution terms before preparing a pilot.
article.detail_en: Vigloo says entrants must present their concept in a video of up to three minutes and submit a synopsis for five episodes. It will consider entries for series production. Production credits, distribution and revenue sharing apply to signed deals. Check whether rights to characters, voices and assets cover production and distribution beyond the pilot. Contest rankings and production decisions are separate.
